title: Fast Length-Squared Sampling for Positive-Semidefinite Matrices
abstract: arXiv:2608.12503v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We describe a simple rejection-sampling-based algorithm to perform length-squared sampling on an $n \times n$ positive-semidefinite (psd) matrix: that is, to sample a column with probability proportional to its squared $\ell_2$-norm. The algorithm runs in just $O(n)$ expected time, which is significantly sublinear in the input matrix size. The runtime is optimal, even when the input is assumed to be diagonal.   Our result has several applications. Length-squared sampling is used by a number of sublinear time algorithms for matrix problems, like low-rank approximation and eigenvalue approximation. Often, it is assumed that the algorithm is given access to the matrix column norms, and thus can perform length-squared sampling efficiently. Our result shows that, at least for psd matrices, we can remove this assumption. translated_title: 正半定矩阵的快速长度平方采样
translated_abstract: 我们描述了一种基于简单拒绝采样的算法，用于对$n \times n$正半定（psd）矩阵执行长度平方采样：即，以与列平方$\ell_2$范数成比例的概率采样一列。该算法的期望运行时间仅为$O(n)$，这显著低于输入矩阵大小的亚线性。即使假设输入为对角矩阵，该运行时间也是最优的。我们的结果有多个应用。长度平方采样被许多亚线性时间算法用于矩阵问题，如低秩近似和特征值近似。通常，假设算法可以访问矩阵列范数，从而能高效执行长度平方采样。我们的结果表明，至少对于psd矩阵，我们可以去除这一假设。我们还讨论了一个用于估计psd矩阵Frobenius范数的渐近最优算法的应用。
tldr: 本文提出一种期望时间O(n)的拒绝采样算法，实现正半定矩阵的长度平方采样，无需预计算列范数，并应用于亚线性时间矩阵算法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an expected O(n) rejection-sampling algorithm for length-squared sampling of positive-semidefinite matrices without precomputed column norms, with applications to sublinear-time matrix algorithms.
